description: This source file provides utilities for subtitle text correction and formatting within a subtitle synchronization platform. It includes functions for spelling and grammar correction using language-tool-python, entity protection with spaCy, sentence casing, whitespace and punctuation normalization, line wrapping to OTT specifications, and post-processing of subtitle files (e.g., SRT files). The module exposes core functions such as correct_subtitle_text, wrap_lines_for_ott, and apply_additional_compliance_fixes.

methods.name: str _nfkc_normalize(text: str)
methods.description: Performs Unicode NFKC normalization on text.

methods.name: str _normalize_spaces(text: str)
methods.description: Replaces Windows and Mac line endings with Unix, trims trailing spaces, and collapses multiple spaces while preserving newlines.

methods.name: str _sentence_case(s: str)
methods.description: Converts the first alphabetic character in the text to uppercase, respecting initial non-letter characters.

methods.name: Optional[Callable[[],any]] _load_spacy_model(lang: str)
methods.description: Load spaCy small language models lazily, returning a callable that supplies the model when invoked.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,bool]] _spacy_protect_entities(text: str, nlp_loader: Optional[Callable[[], any]])
methods.description: Splits text into tokens, marking named entities as protected spans to prevent alterations during correction.

methods.name: str _apply_language_tool(text: str, lang: str)
methods.description: Attempts to perform grammar and spell corrections via the language-tool-python API, fallback included.

methods.name: str _normalize_punctuation(text: str)
methods.description: Refines punctuation spacing and dash/hyphen handling in the text.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Implements greedy word-wrapping with limits on line length and total line count, balancing or hard-breaking as necessary.

methods.name: str wrap_lines_for_ott(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2)
methods.description: Wraps subtitle cue text into OTT-compatible lines, respecting max characters per line and line count.

methods.name: str correct_subtitle_text( text: str, lang: Optional[str] = None, *, protect_entities: bool = True, sentence_case: bool = True, use_language_tool: bool = True, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2, )
methods.description: Performs normalization, optional entity protection, sentence casing, grammar correction, punctuation normalization, and OTT line wrapping on input subtitle text.

methods.name: str apply_additional_compliance_fixes(path: str, processed_dir: str)
methods.description: Post-processes subtitle files (e.g., SRT) to apply grammar correction and formatting to each cue, producing a sanitized output file.

ctags.pattern: /^def _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int, max_lines: int) -> List[str]:$/
